title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Sunday, 20 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind hold quiet AI-safety-standards talks as Google unveils its Gemini Cyber model; Albanese meets Tim Cook at Apple HQ ahead of his UN address; Brisbane switches on a new grid-scale battery under the QUEST Hub; and the Gold Coast Suns rout Essendon by 41 points in AFLW. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
